name: Warp cloud software factories landing page by warp.dev
description: A full-length developer-platform landing page uses a strict column grid, faint vertical rules, compact monospace typography, and mostly white space to make dense technical content feel organized. The hero establishes the system with a large typewriter-style headline and pale terminal mockup, then the page alternates feature lists, data dashboards, case studies, enterprise cards, layered diagrams, product tiles, and FAQ rows; saturated electric blue-purple appears mainly as a high-contrast case-study band and selected diagram states.
